purpose: Bounded method evidence, not recipe findings or publication authorization.

sources.access: Relevant full page text read through web open.
sources.claim: Use package cooking guidance; stir during boiling, reserve cooking water before draining and avoid rinsing when starch-assisted sauce adhesion is wanted. Toss pasta with sauce and add reserved water as needed.
sources.application: Conventional hot sauced pasta; identify boiling and finishing dependencies.
sources.exclusion: Manufacturer’s heated sauce finish does not authorize heating every egg/cheese emulsion identically; no universal sauce ratio or safe egg endpoint.

sources.access: Relevant full page text read through web open.
sources.claim: Use pasteurized eggs/egg products for sauces not thoroughly cooked. Raw eggs can carry Salmonella; safe handling and sufficient cooking matter.
sources.application: Egg-containing pasta sauces with light or uncertain cooking.
sources.exclusion: Retail guidance is not a measured validation of a household residual-heat method. A glossy sauce or warm bowl does not specify attained time/temperature.

editorialChecksNotSourceClaims: Separate boiling time, water heating and sauce work. Record retained-water quantity and adjustable additions.
Maintain split ingredient allocations when scaling; identify bowl/skillet capacity and serving temperature.
unknowns: Cheese type, moisture, acidity and fat levels affect a particular sauce; no universal emulsion temperature or substitute ratio established.
limits: No recipe-specific blind-reference findings used. No kitchen test. Quantities, yields, safety changes and identity changes require exception review.
